feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases

entry.title: OP3000 1.0.1
entry.summary: Dual-chip FM synth in the style of the YM2151 and YM2612, with a PSG sub-chip, filter, chorus and delay.

entry.title: MS20XXL 0.2.0
entry.summary: Korg MS-20-style semi-modular mono synth, circuit-modelled from the MS-20 schematics: the KLM-307 (MK2) and KORG35 (MK1) filter boards solved from their circuit equations, Hz/V sockets, the panel's voltage laws. Every MS-20 patch jack in its place, normalled like the hardware, patched by touch; an SQ-10-style sequencer; 63 patches with cables.

entry.title: MPC Sample Rack 1.0.1
entry.summary: Add, remove and turn on or off the plugins in a project's inserts from a RACK page on the Sample. APPLY saves and restarts MPC: save first.

entry.title: MPC Looper 0.6.1
entry.summary: Experimental four-loop stereo insert for MPC OS 3.10.1+. Disk-backed recording up to 32 bars, overdub, undo, tempo sync and Warp, per-loop stop timing, and separate WAV exports. Fixed audio caches; final revision and Gen2 are offline-only.

entry.title: MPC AirLink 1.3.0
entry.summary: Receive classic AirPlay or VBAN audio on an MPC plugin track. Physical-style UI, gain on Q-Link 1, fixed 24 Hz meters and a 120 ms default VBAN buffer. ARMv7/AArch64; MPC OS 3.10.1+.

entry.title: Mono-101 0.5.1
entry.summary: A circuit-modelled SH-101 mono synth: a port of the Lemus engine, which solves the original schematic part by part, modified for the MPC. The manual's 40 sample sounds, user presets named on screen, and a Circuit Bent page based on Nova-mod and more (PWM, triangle VCO, overdrive, VCF FM, LFO range, key trigger, tempo sync). Gen2 only, CPU heavy.

entry.title: Groove Dice 1.11.0
entry.summary: Neo-soul and hip-hop drums with one-bar grooves, layered original sounds, fills and expansion packs. Optional macOS/Windows Pack Builder creates .gdexp packs. UI checked on MPC XL; other models untested for this release. Requires MPC OS 3.10.1+.

entry.title: GPP Link 1.2.0
entry.summary: Send beats over Wi-Fi between your MPC or Force and a folder on your computer (macOS or Windows hub included), with a cassette deck to preview them. Opens a local-network HTTP hub with no password: home or studio networks only.

entry.title: GPP Link 1.1.0
entry.summary: Send beats over Wi-Fi between your MPC or Force and a folder on your computer (macOS or Windows hub included), with a cassette deck to preview them. Opens a local-network HTTP hub with no password: home or studio networks only.

entry.title: Donut Theory 1.15.4
entry.summary: Analog-inspired synthesizer for bass, keys, leads and pads, with two oscillators, dual LFOs and up to 16 editable chord slots. Requires MPC OS 3.10.1 or later.

entry.title: 9X9 1.0.1
entry.summary: A circuit-solved TR-909 for Gen2 MPC devices: kick, snare, toms, rim and clap are the 909's own circuits, solved with Lemus. Hats, ride and crash play the 909's ROMs, which you supply; without them 9W9's samples play. Drive, sends, master bus, extra controls, Latency. CPU heavy, Gen2 only.

entry.title: 8X8 1.0.1
entry.summary: A circuit-solved TR-808 for Gen2 MPC devices: the voices are the 808's own circuits, solved from the schematics with Lemus, not modelled by ear. Same panel as 8W8, plus drive and distortion per voice, reverb and delay sends, a master bus, extra controls and a Latency setting. CPU heavy, Gen2 only.

entry.title: πToniC 1.1.0
entry.summary: A Microtonic-inspired drum machine. πToniC features 8 independent drum voices, each combining filtered noise with a morphing oscillator or WAV sample playback. Its sound engine includes pitch modulation, amplitude envelopes, drive, EQ and individual voice controls. Shared stereo reverb and tempo-synced delay complete the engine.

entry.title: Warpline 1.1.0
entry.summary: Wavetable synth for standalone MPC built on the open-source Vital engine: plays .vital patches (add your own banks in <drive>/Warpline/Patches), 300 factory patches with search and favourites, a 16-step arpeggiator, GRAINZ granular FX with five modes and a 16-slot mod matrix.

entry.title: Voxman 1.0.0
entry.summary: 8 to 20 band vocoder with an internal string carrier, or play it from any track with Voxboy.

entry.title: Voxboy 1.0.0
entry.summary: Carrier send for Voxman: put it on a bass or synth track to make it the vocoder's carrier.

entry.title: VADER 0.10.7
entry.summary: An orbit-based vector synth: an orbiter travels a shape (built-in, maths, or your own SVG or OBJ) or one of 27 modes across four corners; a picture (PNG, JPG) under it plays the sound. Each corner plays overtone generators, one of 14 voices or a WAV sample, with its own envelope. Two timbres, arpeggiator, effects; its screen runs on your phone.

entry.title: Twenty FX 1.0.0
entry.summary: Twenty's filters, ESP, vocoder and patchbay as an insert effect for any track. DSP by Audio Tools' AT20V.

entry.title: Twenty 1.0.0
entry.summary: Semi-modular MS-20-style synth with a 35-jack patchbay. Ported to MPC by Stampman3000; all synthesis DSP is Audio Tools' AT20V, unchanged.

entry.title: Tributary 1.2.6
entry.summary: Sums chosen Elektron Overbridge outputs onto one MPC track over USB. The machine is 48 kHz; the track resamples that to the MPC's 44.1. Capture saves the machine's own 48 kHz samples, locked to the bars. Based on Overwitch.

entry.title: TouchEQ 8 0.1.3
entry.summary: 8-band parametric EQ with a live filled curve and spectrum analyser: pick a band and drag its point with a finger. Each band is one row of four Q-Links (Freq, Gain, Q, Type), and QLink Follow moves the knobs to the band you tap. 48/12 dB cuts, shelves, bells and notch, Adaptive Q, Scale and Mix.

entry.title: Stream 1.0.1
entry.summary: Multichannel USB audio effect send from an MPC to a Mac. Needs BlackHole 64ch and a Mac helper app.

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 1.3.7
entry.summary: The official OpenMPC plugin manager for Gen1 and Gen2 MPCs (32-bit build for Force, Live, One, X, Key; 64-bit for the Live III and kin). Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. Built on poloq's mpc-vst-manager.

entry.title: mpSEEJAY 1.3.0
entry.summary: Two DJ decks for an external DJ mixer: one plugin per deck, each on its own output. Waveforms, tempo and beat-grid detection, sync, pitch fader (MIDI-learnable), cue, hot cues, loops and rolls, a browser with rekordbox playlists, sorting and star ratings, and the 16 pads lit on the MPC. WAV and MP3. Tested on an MPC Live II, MPC OS 3.10.1.

entry.title: Jamiro 1.0.8
entry.summary: Novation X-Station-style polysynth (KS engine): 8 voices, 3 oscillators with sync, FM and ring mod, multimode filter, 2 envelopes, 2 LFOs, arpeggiator and effects. Loads your own X-Station/KS .syx banks from Content/Banks. Independent project, not affiliated with Novation.

entry.title: Downrush 0.1.0
entry.summary: A polyphonic synth running the synth engine of the open-source Deluge community firmware 1.3.0: subtractive, FM and ring mod, sample oscillators, a 24-cable mod matrix, arpeggiator, and it loads and saves Deluge SYNTH preset files. Needs MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. Tested on a Force.

entry.title: Crate Press 0.2.6
entry.summary: Preview stereo character compressor and three-band ducking effect for MPC track and master inserts, with sampler-style color, wow/flutter and eight momentary or latched performance effects. Requires MPC OS 3.10.1 or later.

entry.title: Vulcan Rotary 1.0.1
entry.summary: Six-barrel rotary gate and stutter: the barrels spool up from rest, rates in real gun rounds per minute (2,500 / 4,000 / 6,000 / 7,200).

entry.title: VHS Vibes 1.7.0
entry.summary: A worn video-tape effect: pitch wobble, tape saturation, the Hi-Fi track, generation loss, B-type noise reduction, hum, hiss and crackle, plus deck faults (level control, drift, tracking dropouts, a tilted head) and a dry/wet mix. 46 programs, on a hot pink cassette with reels that turn and a picture that shows the sound.

entry.title: TR-MPC Tap FX 1.3.0
entry.summary: Companion to TR-MPC: sends any slot, or the kit's reverb or delay send, out on its own MPC track, sample-aligned with the kit, so MPC's mixer, submixes and insert effects can process it. Needs TR-MPC in the same project.

entry.title: TR-MPC 1.3.0
entry.summary: A modular 16-slot drum kit: each slot plays any of the 49 voices of athousanddetails' 6W6, 8W8, CW-78 and 9W9 (a 606 kick beside an 808 snare and 909 hats), with per-slot level, tune, decay, drive, pan and sends, one shared reverb, delay and master chain, a randomise module, and a touchscreen skin that reskins each slot to its voice's kit.

entry.title: Prophetic 0.1.0
entry.summary: The Korg Prophecy's synthesis, built on your computer from your own Prophecy v2.0 ROMs: their DSP programs and sound-engine firmware, translated to C++. 128 programs, every parameter, Performance Editor, arpeggiator, 1-8 voices. Gen2; tested on an MPC Live III.

entry.title: MJX MPC Twister 1.0.1
entry.summary: MPC Live III on MPC OS 3.10.1.12 only. Turn your Twister knobs to reach all 16 Q-Links without changing banks. Press a knob to jump to a track or open a shortcut. The lights follow your settings and track selection. Installation needs root access, writes to internal storage, and restarts the MPC app.
